title: An animated icon's flap reads, and a drawn line ends its lap cleanly
goal: Ask's moving icons still fall short on a few kinds of motion: an envelope's flap crosses its body, a plane stops cut off at the top edge, and lines that draw themselves jump when the loop restarts. Make these read as well as the rest, and measure the work on requests nobody tuned for.
notes: From ask-animates-what-it-makes-an-animated-svg-icon, run 20261106-171511-ask: envelope 4, plane 6, wifi loops 3. AskMotionCheck leaves trimStart and trimEnd out of its loop check on purpose, since a checkmark set to end where it began never drew. Rules in AskMotion.principles must stay general: nothing per subject. Pictures: queue/audits/2026-11-06-ask-animates-after-envelope-opening.png and -after-wifi-signal.png.
acceptance: An animated envelope opening reads as asked at 7 or more in the eval, its flap turning on the top edge without crossing the body
A paper plane taking off is never cut off while it is in the frame: it stays inside or leaves completely, reading 7 or more
A motion that draws lines on loops at 7 or more: wifi no longer shrinks to a row of dots before the lap restarts
The held-out set gains animated requests written by someone who has not tuned the prompt, and its total is reported

The envelope flap closes onto the V it starts from: no frame where it lands shallower and then jumps deeper (today 1.76 s shows a shallow V and 1.92 s the full one, queue/audits/2026-11-08-animated-fold-envelope-frames.png)

log.note: digest 2026-11-06, seen by eye, not measured: the same balloon's edges are crisp stopped (2026-11-06-ask-animates-1-icon-and-keys-sc.png) and softer while playing (-2-playing-sc.png). It may be the canvas drawing at a lower size during play. Did not earn a task from two pictures; if the user notices it, it has.

Reproduced on current code (run 20261108-062312-ask): envelope 35.9 (flap turned flat about the top edge's middle, sweeping sideways through the body), plane 38.6 (keyed 5 units up-right, capped room 1.4x, nose sliced by the top edge 0.48-1.08 s), wifi 39.3 (keyed trimStart: waves un-drew one by one and came back together). The old 'row of dots' is not reproducible: WebKit draws nothing at trim 0 (checked with svg-frames on a hand-made file).

Built: (1) rotationX/rotationY offered to Ask and carried in the SVG as a one-axis scale about the hinge (cosine, sampled 48 times a lap), pivot on a fold sets LayerTurn3D.hinge; rules teach a fold over a whole edge. (2) AskMotion.leaving: a key half over the frame edge goes to the nearer of pulled-in or pushed-clear. (3) trimStart on a drawn part refused at planning; rules say lines draw from trimEnd 0, fade, reset unseen. (4) rule: what comes out of a part is drawn behind it, the front part filled white.

Shipped in 41f4aabbe (pushed): folds (rotationX/Y offered, hinge from pivot, SVG carries a fold as a sampled one-axis scale about the hinge), AskMotion.leaving (half-over-the-edge keys go in or wholly out; gone, it re-enters from the far side on a Hold), swingsFitted (a swing under 180 past all the room eases down to fit, not under 0.4 of itself), trimStart on drawn parts refused, AskMotion.hidden (a travelling part inside a closed outline drawn after it: that outline filled white). 123 motion tests, Scripts/test.sh green (exit 0).

Measured (climb, qwen3.8-27b): envelope 35.9 -> 77.8 twice (reads as asked 7 and 7: DONE), wifi 39.3 -> 83.8 and 80.8 (8 and 8, loops 9: DONE), paper plane 38.6 -> 62.6 / 48.3 / 37.6 / 61.5 (reads as asked 6, 5, 4, 6: NOT DONE, bar 7). Held-out gained 8 animated requests (animated-h1..h8) written blind by a subagent; held-out total 56.9 over 53 (animated 37.3), run 20261108-075845-ask-held-out: DONE.

Left for the plane (why it stays open): the model's own design. It draws the plane nearly edge to edge (judge: touches the edges at rest), leaves its speed lines floating after the plane has gone (rule added: marks go with the part or are gone first; the model ignored it once), and exits in ~0.15 s so it looks like it vanishes (rule added: Ease in over 300-500 ms, seen the whole way: the last run read 6). Next try: a tool that fades a part with no keys of its own when what it sits beside leaves, or shrinks a drawing that fills its frame before it moves.

Left rough, not filed: the envelope's letter reads as a dark block rising through the open flap (judge clean 4); the wifi dot comes out a squashed oval. Both are the model's drawing, not motion, and are in the audit's rough list. Filed: find-out-why-ask-s-held-out-drawing-and-video-sc (held-out drawing and video fell between 7 and 8 Nov; this change does not reach them). Chose the flat, no-perspective fold in the SVG over trying to fake perspective because SVG has no 3D and an icon's fold reads the same. Audit: queue/audits/2026-11-08-animated-icon-flap-plane-wifi.json.
Envelope (7) and wifi (8) read as asked and the held-out set gained 8 blind animated requests (total 56.9). The paper plane reads 6 against a bar of 7: open for the next pass.

triage 2026-11-08, read from the envelope contact sheet: the closing flap lands as a shallow V at 1.76 s and pops to the full V by 1.92 s, a visible jump at the end of each lap. Added to the checklist.
